title: Towards Harmless Rawlsian Fairness Regardless of Demographic Prior
reasoning: The paper investigates Rawlsian fairness within machine learning, which is rooted in ethical philosophy. However, the study focuses on the technical and mathematical optimization of training loss variance for group fairness in general classification and regression tasks (using tabular and image datasets like Adult and CelebA) rather than evaluating or benchmarking religious, moral, or ethical reasoning systems as defined in the prompt.
